gaps.title: Trainer feedback loop 100% quarantined
gaps.description: 741/741 feedback rows quarantined; 0 consumable; trainer not learning from paper outcomes
gaps.resolution_command: redis-cli get v2:trainer:feedback:outcomes | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); rows=d if isinstance(d,list) else d.get('rows',[]); reasons={}; [reasons.update({r.get('quarantine_reason','UNKNOWN'):reasons.get(r.get('quarantine_reason','UNKNOWN'),0)+1}) for r in rows[:50]]; print(reasons)"
